title: Feature Request: UI Move "Stop Sensor" to something more inconvenient
body:
The "stop sensor" button is prominently placed on the main menu. User error can cause the "stop sensor" function and "snooze alert" function to be confused -- especially by someone with low blood sugar at 3am who just wants to make the noise stop and clicks through.

This is definitely a PEBKAC issue. But, the risk of clicking incorrectly is ruining an expensive sensor early and that the target audience sometimes experiences mental difficulties (low blood sugar). Additionally, if someone is trying to temporarily take over treatment or just mute the alarm (like a pregnant T1 in labor, or a T1 being hospitalized), the urge to "just 'stop' the alert" seems to pull people towards "stop sensor" more than "snooze".

I think it would be helpful for "stop sensor" to be more inconvenient than "snooze alert" (which currently has the same amount of clicks, even with the "are you sure?" screen).

Possible solutions would be to move "snooze" higher up on the menu, to hide "stop" behind the "settings" or "system status" menu, or to add a more obnoxious "are you sure?" screen that might require more steps (for example, having to type "OFF" in a text box).
